series.name: PV1800-PH1800 Parallel Installation Guide fault codes 80-90
series.notes: This is a SEPARATE documented table, OEM doc 420-00235-03 'PV1800-PH1800 solar inverter parallel installation guide', and it applies to BOTH PV1800 and PH1800 parallel-capable models - the OEM published one guide for both, so a single series is correct here (unlike SERIES 1 vs 3). These codes only appear when 2 or 3 units are paralleled over the CAN communication cable. In parallel the unit table shows up to 3 units in single phase (15 kVA for 5 kVA, 12 kVA for 4 kVA) or 3-phase from 3 units. Codes 80-90 are entirely separate from the 01-77 range and must never be merged with it.

meaning.en: The CAN communication link between paralleled units has failed, so the units cannot coordinate.
meaning.ur: Parallel units ke darmiyan CAN communication link kharab hai jis se units aik doosre se coordinate nahi kar sakte.

causes.en: Communication cables between units are not connected well, loose, or a cable is faulty.
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan communication cables theek se nahi lagi, loose hain ya koi cable kharab hai.

causes.en: A unit is off or unpowered while the parallel group is running.
causes.ur: Parallel group chal raha ho koi unit off ya unpowered hai.

causes.en: Terminations are wrong, so the CAN bus is not properly referenced end to end.
causes.ur: Termination ghalat hai jis se CAN bus poori tarah reference nahi ho raha.

solutions.en: Switch off all units and isolate AC, PV and battery before touching the CAN cabling.
solutions.ur: CAN wiring chhoone se pehle sab units off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Check if communication cables are connected well and restart the inverter, exactly as the guide's row 80 says.
solutions.ur: Guide ki 80 row ke mutabiq check karein ke communication cables theek lagi hain aur inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: If the problem remains, contact the installer, because this table's remedy ends there.
solutions.ur: Agar masla bache to installer se rabta karein, kyun ke is table ka hal yahan khatam hota hai.

source.title: PV1800-PH1800 Solar Inverter Parallel Installation Guide (OEM doc 420-00235-03)

meaning.en: A parallel unit has lost the master/host unit it was following.
meaning.ur: Ek parallel unit ne us host unit ko kho diya jiski woh follow kar raha tha.

causes.en: The host unit is powered off while follower units are still running.
causes.ur: Host unit power off hai jab ke follower units abhi chal rahe hain.

causes.en: The CAN link to the host has dropped because of a loose or damaged cable.
causes.ur: Host se CAN link loose ya damaged cable ki wajah se gir gaya hai.

solutions.en: Power down the whole parallel group, then re-power every unit together in the guide's commissioning order.
solutions.ur: Poore parallel group ko power down karein, phir sab units ko guide ke commissioning order mein saath chalaayein.

solutions.en: Check the communication cable seating at each unit and reseat the CAN connectors.
solutions.ur: Har unit par communication cable ki seating check karke CAN connectors dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Contact the installer if the host keeps dropping, since the host and slave roles are randomly assigned.
solutions.ur: Agar host baar baar girta rahe to installer se rabta karein, host aur slave roles randomly assign hote hain.

source.title: PV1800-PH1800 Solar Inverter Parallel Installation Guide (OEM doc 420-00235-03)

meaning.en: A unit has lost synchronisation with the parallel group, so it stops to avoid a back-feed clash.
meaning.ur: Aik unit parallel group ke saath synchronization kho gaya aur back-feed clash se bachne ke liye ruk gaya.

causes.en: Not all units had their AC line breakers closed at the same time after a supply interruption.
causes.ur: Supply interruption ke baad sab units ke AC line breakers ek saath band nahi hue.

causes.en: A communication cable is loose, so one unit cannot sample the group waveform.
causes.ur: Communication cable loose hai jis se aik unit group waveform sample nahi kar sakta.

solutions.en: The guide notes that units showing 82 will automatically restart, so first switch on all AC line breakers to the grid at the same time.
solutions.ur: Guide ke mutabiq 82 dikhane wale units khud restart ho jate hain, is liye pehle grid ke saare AC line breakers ek saath on karein.

solutions.en: If AC connection is detected again, they work normally, so check that all units see AC before investigating further.
solutions.ur: Agar AC connection dobara detect ho jaye to ye normal chalte hain, is liye aage jaane se pehle check karein ke sab units AC dekh rahe hain.

solutions.en: Re-seat and reseat-check the CAN cables on every unit, then restart the group together.
solutions.ur: Har unit par CAN cables dobara baithayein aur check karein, phir group ko saath restart karein.

source.title: PV1800-PH1800 Solar Inverter Parallel Installation Guide (OEM doc 420-00235-03)

title.ur: Battery voltage units mein different hai

meaning.en: The units in the parallel group see different battery voltages, which the guide ties to not sharing the same battery banks.
meaning.ur: Parallel group ke units ke battery voltages alag hain, guide isay same battery banks share na karne se jodta hai.

causes.en: All inverters do not share the same groups of batteries together.
causes.ur: Sab inverters ek hi battery group share nahi kar rahe.

causes.en: One unit's battery fuse or string is open, so it reads a different voltage.
causes.ur: Aik unit ka battery fuse ya string khula hai jis se voltage alag dikhta hai.

solutions.en: Make sure all inverters share same groups of batteries together, as the guide's row 83 states.
solutions.ur: Guide ki 83 row ke mutabiq ensure karein ke sab inverters ek hi battery group share karein.

solutions.en: Measure each unit's battery voltage on the LCD and identify which unit is reading low.
solutions.ur: LCD par har unit ka battery voltage check karke dekhein ke kaun sa unit low par hai.

solutions.en: Check the battery fuse and each string on the odd unit, then contact the installer if it persists.
solutions.ur: Odd unit ka battery fuse aur har string check karein, phir masla barqarar rahe to installer se rabta karein.

source.title: PV1800-PH1800 Solar Inverter Parallel Installation Guide (OEM doc 420-00235-03)

title.ur: AC input voltage ya frequency alag hai

meaning.en: Parallel units are seeing different AC input voltage or frequency, so they cannot be in the same phase.
meaning.ur: Parallel units alag AC input voltage ya frequency dekh rahe hain jis se woh same phase mein nahi ho sakte.

causes.en: The utility wiring connection differs or is loose between units.
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan utility wiring connection alag ya loose hai.

causes.en: One unit is fed by a generator while the others are on utility, or breaker phases differ.
causes.ur: Aik unit generator par hai aur baqi utility par, ya breaker phases alag hain.

solutions.en: Check the utility wiring connection and restart the inverter, as the guide's row 84 says.
solutions.ur: Guide ki 84 row ke mutabiq utility wiring connection check karke inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Measure AC input voltage and frequency at each unit's input terminal with a multimeter and compare.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke input terminal par multimeter se AC input voltage aur frequency check karke compare karein.

solutions.en: Confirm every parallel unit is fed from the same source and the same phase, then contact the installer if it remains.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke har parallel unit aik hi source aur aik hi phase se aata hai, phir masla rahe to installer se rabta karein.

source.title: PV1800-PH1800 Solar Inverter Parallel Installation Guide (OEM doc 420-00235-03)

title.en: AC output current unbalance in parallel
title.ur: AC output current parallel mein unbalanced

meaning.en: The units in the parallel group are not sharing output current evenly.
meaning.ur: Parallel group ke units output current barabar share nahi kar rahe.

causes.en: Units restarted at different times so their output current sharing loop has not settled.
causes.ur: Units alag alag time par restart hue jis se current sharing loop settle nahi hua.

causes.en: A unit is overloaded relative to the others.
causes.ur: Aik unit doosron ke muqabl overload hai.

causes.en: One unit's current sensing is drifting, so it reports the wrong share.
causes.ur: Aik unit ka current sensing bigad raha hai jis se woh galat share report karta hai.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter, which is the guide's stated remedy for 85.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein, ye guide ka bataya hua hal hai 85 ke liye.

solutions.en: Then confirm each unit's load current on the LCD is roughly equal.
solutions.ur: Phir LCD par har unit ka load current check karein ke taqreeban barabar hai.

solutions.en: If one unit is persistently lower, check its current sensor and its load, then contact the installer.
solutions.ur: Agar aik unit baar baar kam dikh raha ho to uska current sensor aur load check karein, phir installer se rabta karein.

source.title: PV1800-PH1800 Solar Inverter Parallel Installation Guide (OEM doc 420-00235-03)

title.ur: AC output mode setting alag hai

meaning.en: Parallel units are configured with different AC output modes, so the group cannot run as one.
meaning.ur: Parallel units alag alag AC output mode mein set hain jis se group ek jaisa chal nahi sakta.

causes.en: The DIP switch setting is different between units.
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan DIP switch setting alag hai.

causes.en: The working mode was changed on one unit only after the group was commissioned.
causes.ur: Group commission hone ke baad sirf aik unit par working mode badal diya gaya.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and check the DIP switch setting, as the guide's row 86 directs.
solutions.ur: Inverter off karke DIP switch setting check karein, jaisa guide ki 86 row kehti hai.

solutions.en: Set the same working mode on every unit from the LCD, then restart the group together.
solutions.ur: LCD se har unit par aik hi working mode set karein, phir group ko saath restart karein.

solutions.en: Check every unit's DIP switch position against the guide's per-unit table, then contact the installer.
solutions.ur: Har unit ki DIP switch position ko guide ki per-unit table se check karein, phir installer se rabta karein.

source.title: PV1800-PH1800 Solar Inverter Parallel Installation Guide (OEM doc 420-00235-03)

title.ur: Inverter mein power feedback detect hui

meaning.en: Current has been detected flowing back into an inverter, so the unit protects itself.
meaning.ur: Inverter mein current wapas aa raha hai jis se unit apni protection chala raha hai.

causes.en: The current sharing link between parallel units is not connected, so units fight for output.
causes.ur: Parallel units ke darmiyan current sharing link nahi lagi jis se units output ke liye ladte hain.

causes.en: A unit was powered up out of sequence relative to the others.
causes.ur: Aik unit baqi ke muqabl out of sequence par power up kiya gaya.

causes.en: A back-feed path exists through load or grid wiring outside the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter ke bahar load ya grid wiring se back-feed ka raasta mojood hai.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter, which is the guide's stated remedy for 87.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein, ye guide ka bataya hua hal hai 87 ke liye.

solutions.en: Check if communication cables are connected well and confirm the current sharing cable is in place between units.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke communication cables theek lagi hain aur units ke darmiyan current sharing cable lagi hai.

solutions.en: If it returns, contact the installer, because persistent back-feed usually means wrong parallel wiring.
solutions.ur: Wapas aaye to installer se rabta karein, barqarar back-feed aam tor par galat parallel wiring ka matlab hai.

source.title: PV1800-PH1800 Solar Inverter Parallel Installation Guide (OEM doc 420-00235-03)

meaning.en: The units in the parallel group are running different firmware versions, so they will not share load correctly.
meaning.ur: Parallel group ke units alag alag firmware version par chal rahe hain jis se woh load sahi share nahi kar sakte.

causes.en: One or more units were updated and the rest were not.
causes.ur: Aik ya kai units update hue lekin baqi nahi hue.

causes.en: A unit was replaced with a different production batch carrying older firmware.
causes.ur: Aik unit alag batch ka lagaya gaya jisme purana firmware hai.

solutions.en: Update all inverter firmware to the same version, which is the guide's row 88 remedy.
solutions.ur: Sab inverters ka firmware aik hi version par update karein, ye guide ki 88 row ka hal hai.

solutions.en: Note each unit's current version on the LCD before updating, so you can confirm the versions match afterwards.
solutions.ur: Update se pehle LCD se har unit ka current version note karein taake baad mein match confirm kar sakein.

solutions.en: Get the firmware from the OEM manual/download portal for the exact model, and if the problem remains contact the installer.
solutions.ur: Firmware usi model ke liye OEM manual ya download portal se lein, aur masla bache to installer se rabta karein.

source.title: PV1800-PH1800 Solar Inverter Parallel Installation Guide (OEM doc 420-00235-03)

title.ur: Units ka output current alag alag hai

meaning.en: The output current of each unit in the group is different, so the current sharing link is not working.
meaning.ur: Group mein har unit ka output current alag hai jis se current sharing link kaam nahi kar rahi.

causes.en: Communication cables between units are not connected well.
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan communication cables theek se nahi lagi hain.

causes.en: One unit's current sensor is faulty so it does not report its true share.
causes.ur: Aik unit ka current sensor kharab hai jis se woh apni asal share report nahi kar raha.

solutions.en: Check if communication cables are connected well and restart the inverter, as the guide's row 89 says.
solutions.ur: Guide ki 89 row ke mutabiq communication cables check karke inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Switch off the whole group, reseat every CAN and current sharing cable, and re-power all units together.
solutions.ur: Poora group off karke har CAN aur current sharing cable dobara baithayein, aur sab units saath chalaayein.

solutions.en: If the problem remains, contact the installer.
solutions.ur: Agar masla bache to installer se rabta karein.

source.title: PV1800-PH1800 Solar Inverter Parallel Installation Guide (OEM doc 420-00235-03)

title.en: CAN ID / DIP switch setting error
title.ur: CAN ID ya DIP switch setting error

meaning.en: The units in the parallel group do not have unique CAN IDs, so they cannot be addressed individually.
meaning.ur: Parallel group ke units ke CAN ID unique nahi hain jis se unhein alag alag address nahi kiya ja sakta.

causes.en: Two or more units have the same DIP switch position, so they share one CAN ID.
causes.ur: Do ya zyada units ki DIP switch position aik hi hai jis se woh aik hi CAN ID share karte hain.

causes.en: The DIP switch is in an undefined position, with neither the master nor the slave pattern set.
causes.ur: DIP switch undefined position par hai, na master na slave pattern set hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and check the DIP switch setting, which is the guide's row 90 remedy.
solutions.ur: Inverter off karke DIP switch setting check karein, ye guide ki 90 row ka hal hai.

solutions.en: For a two-unit single-phase setup, set one unit to key 1 down and keys 2,3,4,5 up, and the other unit to key 2 down and keys 1,3,4,5 up.
solutions.ur: Do unit ki single-phase setup mein aik unit ka key 1 neeche aur keys 2,3,4,5 up, aur doosre ka key 2 neeche aur keys 1,3,4,5 up set karein.

solutions.en: For three-phase operation, use the guide's three inverters wiring diagram and assign a distinct DIP pattern to each unit.
solutions.ur: Three-phase operation ke liye guide ka teen inverters wiring diagram use karein aur har unit ko alag DIP pattern dein.

source.title: PV1800-PH1800 Solar Inverter Parallel Installation Guide (OEM doc 420-00235-03)
